property_summary: In the reference, a call by a non-owner always fails at the owner check and reverts with empty revert data, regardless of the receiver's behaviour; the mutant performs the transfer first, so a non-owner call to a reverting receiver bubbles up the receiver's non-empty revert data, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Move the owner check to after the transfer so funds are sent before reverting on unauthorized calls.
